name: @forge/ext-demo-gate
description: Forge extension (DEMO-GATE): the public demo's gate app. Fills the neutral theme slot `storefront:gate` with a full-screen interstitial ("Demo store" — a fictional-environment notice + the two paths, store and admin). "Open the store" sets the dismissal cookie and continues (deep link preserved); "Open the admin" hands off to the admin's /enter route, which redeems an operator access key server-side (the key never reaches the browser). PT/EN/ES embedded. The theme owns the slot; this app is its first consumer.
